messages:
mira_support: FYI: ACME (acme-prod) reporting sudden p99 latency ~18s + 503s during billing window, started ~03:14 UTC. Customer escalated. Requesting triage.

james_sre: Assigning. Any request ids or samples?

acme_ops: Attaching logs: saw attach_timeout + auth_refresh_failed. req ids: ab12cd, ef34gh. sample log: `2026-03-16T03:15:22Z req=ab12cd status=attach_timeout pool=dedicated-acme min_pool=1`

lex_platform: Looks like Dedicated min_pool=1 for acme-prod. Hot attach count spiked; many cold GPU starts. Pool saturated. +1 to increase min.

sam_runtime: Also hitting image-pull latency on cold starts: `image_pull=1.8s` on several nodes. Combined with handshake adds up.

james_sre: Mitigations: (1) bump min_pool to 3 temporarily, (2) enable hot_attach for acme-prod, (3) reroute priority traffic to hosted fallback. I'll run the commands — @lex_platform can you approve capacity bump?

lex_platform: Approve. I'll open a capacity ticket to reserve 2 extra GPUs. Also adding a short-lived prewarm policy.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: apply config change to acme-prod min_pool=3 at 03:23 UTC.

mira_support: Customer notified of mitigation path. Asking for repro steps and timeline.

james_sre: Repro steps I used (internal):
```bash
# simulate burst
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```
Observed attach_timeout around 1m for several connects.

acme_ops: Can you confirm we won't hit billing overage? They worry.

lex_platform: This is temporary config change; will monitor. If we need longer, we'll create committed reserved add-on and discuss billing.

sam_runtime: Follow-up: collect p95/p99 over next 30m, check model cache init times. Extract trace ids and attach to ticket.

james_sre: Logged incident ticket INC-2026-1297, attaching logs and timeline. Owner: james_sre. Next: verify error rate drop and p99 back to baseline.

mira_support: :thumbsup: I'll update customer and close escalation when metrics stable for 15m.

acme_ops: Thanks. Keep me posted, we're running demo at 04:00 UTC.

james_sre: Metrics after fixes: p99 down from 18s -> 2.2s, 503s dropped to 0. Reopen if recurs.

mira_support: Closing thread, will do postmortem. Action items: add warmup image caching, review min_pool defaults, add better attach-metrics.
